description: Search plain-language pet and animal care guides across PawLine's 11-site network (senior pets, puppies, kittens, anxious dogs, multi-pet homes, New England emergencies, horses, backyard goats/sheep/chickens, exotics, 4-H show prep). Use this when someone asks a pet care question, to find sourced guides with links to share.

query.description: The pet question or topic, e.g. "my 12-year-old lab limps after stairs"

site.description: Optional site domain to search only one site, e.g. seniordognotes.com

name: search_pet_guides
